en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika) and the Dyad on Abandonable by Development (Bhāvanāyapahātabbaduka).

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, which is to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor non-reactive and not to be abandoned by cultivation, by way of the root condition.
(Abbreviated. There are six [conditions] for the root; six for the predominance ... pe ... six for non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, which is not to be abandoned by cultivation, there does not arise a state that is non-demonstrable and with-reactive...

A state to be abandoned by means of repeated cultivation arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are three; ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition there are three.
